sentences.en: The youth in Malaysia really like Korean and Japanese celebrities.
sentences.zh: 马来西亚的年轻人真的很喜欢韩国和日本的明星。

sentences.en: Muslim traders from Arabia introduced Islam to Malaysia and Indonesia.
sentences.zh: 阿拉伯地区的穆斯林商人将伊斯兰教传入了马来西亚和印度尼西亚。

sentences.en: Sebatik Island is a border area between Indonesia and Malaysia.
sentences.zh: 塞巴蒂岛是印度尼西亚和马来西亚的边境地区。
